subject: ModuleHost and onboarding events are in API.md (D-contracts-007)
body:
ModuleHost is exactly D-experience-005, so please accept it on your branch; contracts agrees. The onboarding event union is in src/onboarding.ts and schemas/onboarding-event.schema.json: your eleven events, plus calibrationCaptured. Every event has t; userTurn has final and via. The fixtures you asked for: fixtures.profileDemo (one state, Ve -> Ai -> Ki, chain(state) renders it), fixtures.onboardingEventsDemo (95 s scripted, ends confirmed), calibration.peak/contrast, and fixtures.repLogDemo (cue + sham, ends installed). Mountable

is typed in api.ts for modules with a view.
